Scoring complete. Both files written.

**Gold file:** `gold.json` (no `golden.json` in the case dir). I read `ranked.json` in full before opening the gold.

**Answer shape:** flat array of 65 paths — single-repo form, which is the form `gold.json` uses, so no flattening was needed. Scorer agrees: `case_family: "single-repo"`, `gold_schema: "verified-no-split"`.

**Metrics** (`python3 score_arm.py …`, exit 0, no stderr):

| metric | value |
|---|---|
| hits / gold_total | 4 / 8 |
| recall@10 | 0.375 |
| recall@20 | 0.375 |
| recall@25 | 0.375 |
| recall@50 | 0.500 |
| recall@75 (full, list cap) | 0.500 |
| precision@5 | 0.400 |
| MRR | 1.000 |

The scorer does not emit precision@10, precision@20, F1@20 or F1_full_list — it computes only `recall@{10,20,25,50,75}`, `precision@5`, `MRR`, and the two null core/propagation splits. I did not substitute hand arithmetic for the missing four. `degenerate_ks: [75]` — the list is 65 long, so recall@75 is just full-list recall.

**Found** (rank in parentheses):
- (1) `packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts`
- (4) `packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts`
- (7) `packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts`
- (45) `packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/types.ts`

**missed_gold:**
- `apps/api/v2/src/ee/bookings/2024-04-15/controllers/bookings.controller.ts`
- `apps/api/v2/src/ee/bookings/2024-08-13/services/input.service.ts`
- `packages/features/tasker/tasks/sendWorkflowEmails.ts`
- `packages/prisma/zod-utils.ts`

**Surface verdict: NOT comparable.** Derived from `commands.log` (33 calls): stakeout 9, collateral_damage 8, the_receipts 7, manhunt 4, ToolSearch 1, blueprint 1, case_file 1, rap_sheet 1, roll_call 1. The reason is not the tool surface — every call is a plumbline tool plus one ToolSearch schema load, no filesystem or shell tool appears, and the retriever's own search tool (`stakeout`) was called 9 times, so what was measured is the intended retriever. The sole disqualifier is caching: `cache_read=1831307`, `cache_creation=165820`, a warm run, so the $3.467 / 757,692 ms figures are not cost-comparable to cold runs. The scorer's own surface block reports `not_comparable: []`; I kept it verbatim as `surface_scorer` and wrote the spec-derived block, which includes the cache check, as `surface`.

**What the misses share:** all four sit at the boundaries of the workflow-email path rather than inside it. Two are the v2 REST API layer (`bookings.controller.ts`, `input.service.ts`) — a separate application under `apps/api/v2` that reaches the same booking flow through its own controller/service pair; one is the Tasker job (`sendWorkflowEmails.ts`) that is the deferred execution end of the scheduling the run did retrieve; one is the shared Zod schema module (`packages/prisma/zod-utils.ts`), a type/validation substrate. The run's four hits are all in the orchestration register — the scheduler, the workflow service, the booking service, the workflow types — clustered in `packages/features/ee/workflows` and `packages/features/bookings`. The misses are the layers on either side of that band: the inbound API surface above it and the queued-task executor plus the schema definitions below it, none of which carry the branding vocabulary the run keyed on.
